info.description: UCell Core API — Rule Version R1.0B FROZEN

membershipState.description: Null means pre-V1.1 legacy state has not been classified; never inferred from Qualification.

truncated.description: True means bounded response; further pagination is not yet available.

readAt.description: First persisted Person read evidence; not LINE read state.

pv.description: Checkout does not recognize PV; null.

total.description: Core authoritative decimal-string TWD product amount; never client-computed.

price.description: Display only; Create Order revalidates Core price.

available.description: Orderable by effective traceable product profile; does not confirm ERP stock.

monthlyRepurchaseStatus.description: Core recognition schedule status; frontend cannot derive Active entitlement.

bonusAmount.description: Unfinalized settlement is null, not zero.

amount.description: Null for unfinalized or absent lifecycle evidence.

total.description: Display DTO only; not input to mutation.

accessToken.description: Opaque UCell bearer, not LINE token.

idToken.description: LINE ID token; verified server-side, never logged or persisted raw

accepted.description: Explicit acceptance is required; false is never recorded as consent.

intent.description: Optional fixed intent marker; no Person, session or Qualification identifiers accepted.

name.description: Display name only; legal identity is immutable through Member API

phone.description: Contact data only; does not bind or authenticate an identity

qualificationId.description: Selected Qualification; server checks authenticated Person ownership on every request
Selected Qualification; server checks authenticated Person ownership on every request

items.description: Product IDs and quantities only; Core determines price/rule snapshots. RETAIL purpose only.

token.description: Opaque encrypted token from a server-issued referral URL

anonymousId.description: Anonymous browser identifier returned by the first landing; server generates it when absent.

transitionState.description: Opaque server-signed transition state returned by referral landing

gender.description: Version-neutral gender code; display labels are client/localization concerns.

sourceReferralToken.description: 分享歸因Token，Server只存Hash/解析結果
